info.title: Betsi Patient Flow API
info.description: Patient flow and escalation for emergency departments. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable 'code'. See docs/API.md and docs/API-VERSIONING.md.

post.summary: Assigns clinical staff and records whether paediatric competence is held.
Records whether a carer is currently with the patient.
Raises a safeguarding concern and its linked escalation atomically.
Records clinical deterioration and raises its linked escalation atomically.
Submits one command. A retry with the same idempotency key returns the original result.

get.summary: One episode: demographics, state, timings and its escalations.
Patients waiting or awaiting treatment, longest wait first, a page at a time.

parameters.name: minWaitingMinutes
parameters.description: Only patients who have waited at least this long.

parameters.name: minAgeYears
parameters.description: Only patients at least this old.

parameters.name: maxAgeYears
parameters.description: Only patients at most this old, e.g. 17 for paediatrics.

get.summary: The revision in force, and every revision with its approval history.

post.summary: Shows how many patients waiting right now each proposed tier would apply to. Changes nothing.
Proposes a new revision. It has no effect until approved.
Proposes a new revision restoring an earlier approved revision.
Approves a proposal. Must be a different, supervisory user from the proposer.
Withdraws a proposal, or an approval that has not yet taken effect.

get.summary:
The escalation board: awaiting acknowledgement, active, open follow-up exceptions,
recent history, metrics, and whether a policy is in force.

parameters.name: historyDays
parameters.description: How many days of resolved and closed escalations to include (1–30, default 7).

get.summary: Every recorded transition of an escalation and its follow-up exceptions, oldest first.

post.summary: Raises an escalation because a patient has breached a waiting-time threshold.
Acknowledges an escalation, confirming someone has taken it on. Repeating it is harmless.
Resolves an escalation once the underlying issue has been dealt with. Repeating it is harmless.
Reassigns an escalation to another role, which must acknowledge it against a new deadline.
Records the review of a missed acknowledgement and closes the follow-up exception.

get.summary: Recent messages from a source, without bodies. Filter by `Quarantined` to find messages needing review.
One message, including the body of a quarantined message. Contains patient data; the read is audited.

post.summary:
Receives one signed HL7 v2 or FHIR R4 message. Authenticated by the `Betsi-Signature`
header, not a bearer token. Requires `Betsi-Message-Id`; resending the same id is safe.
post.description:
A message that cannot be processed is quarantined and still acknowledged as received (HL7
`AE`, or `status: Quarantined`), so the sender does not retry a message that will
never succeed. Quarantined messages are listed for review.

get.summary: Licence status for the tenant named on the request.

post.summary: Creates a location such as a bay, cubicle or waiting area.
Creates a queue for a location.
Adds a patient to the end of a queue.
Records an observation or a correction preserving the original measurements.

get.summary: Returns original and corrected observations in recording order.

post.summary: Registers a patient's arrival, opening a new episode.
Begins triage for a waiting patient.
Completes triage, moving the patient to awaiting treatment.
Moves the patient into treatment at a location.
Discharges the patient, ending the episode.
Cancels the episode, for example a patient who left without being seen.
Subscribes a URL to event types. The signing secret is in the response and is never shown again.

get.summary: The event types that can be subscribed to.

effectiveFrom.description: UTC. Omit to take effect immediately.

AssessmentFinding.description:
A deliberately non-diagnostic structured finding. Site-approved clinical detail remains
in the adjacent text field; this enum must not be interpreted as a score or trigger.

AssignClinicalStaffCommand.description: Assigns a clinician to an episode and records paediatric competence (MVP-033).

BeginPatientTreatmentCommand.description: Command to move patient to treatment area.

CancelPatientEpisodeCommand.description: Command to cancel an episode, for example a patient who left without being seen.

CloseFollowUpExceptionCommand.description: Records the supervisory review of a missed acknowledgement and closes the exception.

commandType.description: The command name without the "Command" suffix, e.g. `RegisterPatient`.

commandId.description: Client-generated id for this command, echoed in the response and logs.

idempotencyKey.description: Retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting again.

correlationId.description: Carried through logs so one user action can be traced across systems.

expectedVersion.description: For commands against an existing record: the version the client last read.

aggregateId.description: Identifier of the aggregate the command created or changed.

version.description: The aggregate's version after the command was applied.

CommandResult.description: What a command produced: the aggregate it affected and the version it left behind.

CompletePatientTriageCommand.description: Command to complete patient triage and move to awaiting treatment.

Consciousness.description: Level of consciousness, as NEWS2 records it (ACVPU).

CreateLocationCommand.description: Command to create a new location (bed/room).

CreateQueueCommand.description: Command to create a new queue for a location.

EnqueuePatientCommand.description: Command to enqueue a patient in a queue.

EpisodeDetail.description: The canonical view of one episode (spec §4.1: `GET /episodes/{id}`).

source.description: Where the data came from; the spec requires every view to say.

truncated.description: True if a list hit its limit; the board must say more exist.

EscalationBoard.description: Everything the escalation board shows, as of Betsi.Application.Escalations.EscalationBoard.GeneratedAt.

reason.description: What the clinician observed: "declining consciousness", "respiratory distress".

responsibleRole.description: Who should respond. Defaults to the site's senior clinical role.

FlagPatientDeteriorationCommand.description: A clinician's judgement that a patient is deteriorating, which escalates (MVP-041).

status.description: Why the licence is or is not in force, e.g. Valid, GracePeriod, Expired.

mode.description: Full, or Restricted — licence-gated operations refused; patient care continues.

features.description: Features currently usable. Empty in restricted mode.

PainScale.description: Which pain scale a score came from. A number without its scale means nothing.

PolicyPreview.description: What a candidate set of tiers would do to the patients waiting right now.

status.description:
`InForce`, `Disabled` (the site turned automatic escalation off), or
            `NoApprovedPolicy` — shown prominently so nobody assumes escalations are being raised.

tiers.description: In threshold order. Levels are assigned 1, 2, 3… in the order given.

ProposeEscalationPolicyCommand.description: Proposes a new policy revision. Takes no effect until someone else approves it.

ProposeEscalationPolicyRestorationComman.description: Proposes a new revision restoring an earlier approved one (rollback).

reason.description: What was observed. Clinical free text; never leaves the tenant database.

responsibleRole.description: Overrides the site's default safeguarding role, when one is known locally.

RaiseSafeguardingConcernCommand.description: Raises a safeguarding concern, which escalates immediately (MVP-032).

ReassignEscalationCommand.description: Hands an escalation to a different role, which must acknowledge it afresh.

carerName.description: Required when a carer is present.

RecordCarerPresenceCommand.description: Records who is with the patient, or that nobody is (MVP-034).

kind.description: Routine, Triage or Concern. A correction is implied by Betsi.Application.Commands.RecordObservationCommand.SupersedesObservationId.

painLocation.description: Where the patient reports or displays pain.

painCharacter.description: Clinical description such as sharp, burning or cramping.

painOnsetAt.description: When the current pain began, when known.

supersedesObservationId.description:
The observation this one corrects. The earlier one is kept and marked superseded;
nothing is ever edited or deleted.

expectedVersion.description: Required for corrections: the version of the observation being superseded.

RecordObservationCommand.description: Records a set of observations for a patient (MVP-040, MVP-042).

RegisterPatientCommand.description: Command to register a new patient episode (patient arrival).

TriggerWaitingTimeEscalationCommand.description: Command to trigger an escalation for a waiting-time threshold.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

WebhookSecretIssued.description: Returned once, at creation or rotation. The secret is not retrievable afterwards.

Bearer.description: An access token from the configured OIDC provider. In Development the X-Betsi headers may be used instead.
